_source: SIA 265:2021, clause 4.5 (Bemessungssituation Brand), Tabelle 13 and equations (48) to (51) -- transcribed by hand from the German edition, ExternalFiles/000-Normes/SIA265-2021-DE.pdf pp. 38-40, Tabelle 13 and (51) read off a render of p. 40 (the table's rows and the sign of (51) do not extract as text). Checked against the French edition, SIA265-2021-FR.pdf (Tableau 13, «Vitesse de combustion théorique»).
_note: The ideal residual cross-section of 4.5.2.2: d_ef = d_char,n + d_red (49), d_char,n = beta_n · t (50), the original section reduced by d_ef on every exposed face and taken as sharp-edged (Figur 13). d_red is «mindestens 7 mm» for a fire resistance up to 90 minutes; beyond 90 the clause states none, so a longer duration is not computed. 4.5.2.4's minimum width b holds for an action on several faces at once: 80 mm for R30, 140 mm for R60, and the clause states none above R60. (51) is R_d,fi ≈ 1.8 · R_d, R_d being the design resistance of the residual section at normal temperature; k_h (3.4.2.3) and k_sys (5.7.2.2) are not applied. 4.5.2.2's simplification E_d,fi = 0.6 · E_d (Kategorie A and B only) is kept for the record: Woodcore takes E_d,fi as the engineer writes it. The rows of Tabelle 13 are the norm's own: `woods` names which choice of the engineer each row is read for -- `softwood` is any grade SIA 265 lists as Nadelholz, `beech`, `oak` and `cladding` are asked of him --, `families` which family of Tabelle 8/9 (`Vollholz` stands for Vollholz, keilgezinktes Vollholz and Balkenschichtholz); Holzwerkstoffe are «siehe Lignum-Dokumentation Brandschutz» and absent here. The footnote 1) of the table (glued products: «Bei Einsatz von im Brandfall beständigen Klebstofftypen») is carried as `adhesive_note`.
